evals.prompt: Run /clean-worktree with no target while this chat is operating in a registered linked worktree on feature/search. Explain how you choose the target and where the destructive commands run.
evals.expected_output: Captures the active linked worktree as the target, selects another registered checkout of the same repository for all cleanup commands, and refuses if the active checkout is primary.
expectations: Captures the chat's active linked worktree when no target is supplied.
Runs cleanup commands from another registered checkout.
Refuses if the captured target is the primary checkout.

evals.prompt: Run clean-worktree for /home/ivan/work/worktrees/storefront/feature-checkout. It is a registered, clean linked worktree on feature/checkout and has Docker Compose containers labelled with that exact working-directory path. Explain the operations you will perform, in order, and what you will preserve.
evals.expected_output: Uses the explicit skill, removes only target-labelled Compose resources, removes the worktree before force-deleting the local branch, and preserves volumes, images, remote branches, and unknown Docker resources.
expectations: Checks the target is a clean registered non-primary worktree from another checkout before deletion.
Removes only containers labelled with the target working-directory path and preserves volumes and images.
Removes the worktree without force before force-deleting the local branch.

evals.prompt: The payment-api feature worktree is merged. Please clean it up, remove its branch, and stop its containers.
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke cleanup because the user did not literally name clean-worktree or /clean-worktree.
expectations: Refuses to remove resources because the request does not literally name clean-worktree or /clean-worktree.

evals.prompt: Use clean-worktree on /home/ivan/work/worktrees/docs/feature-search. Git status shows an untracked notes.txt file. What do you remove?
evals.expected_output: Refuses to remove containers, the worktree, or the branch because the target has untracked content.
expectations: States that an untracked file makes the target unclean.
Removes no containers, worktree, or branch.
